title: mcp/server approval entry
description: MCP spawn approval list entry (governance dataset org.evorule.mcp.servers). Strict builtin: server_key/command/comment are always required; the approval attribution trio (approved_by/approved_at/approval_ref) is enforced by the store code gates rather than this schema, because it is status-conditional - proposal-form entries (Draft/Candidate, machine-proposed) legitimately omit it (a proposal is a request, not an approval), while promotion to Active (any path) and direct Active/Published writes require it complete (the human approve action fills it from the approver identity). server_key must equal the canonical hash of command+args_pattern; the cross-field checks live in the store write core and the Active promotion gate. entry_id convention = server_key. The executor side (agent spawn gate) mirrors this contract and aligns via shared golden vector tests. task_ref (optional) marks proposals that originated from (or blocked) an unattended task - written by the proposal intake, consumed by approval-queue filtering.

scan_report.description: Optional inspection scan report attached to the proposal (executor mcp-inspect output: scanner_version/scanned_at/tools_listed/ioc_hits/llm_advisory/rules_source + report_hash). Optional - a proposal without a scan report is admitted as unscanned (visible to the approver). Shape and integrity hash are enforced by the model code gate (validate_scan_report), not this schema.
